rationale: Create one active Macquarie Infrastructure Partners V short-line freight-rail platform. The present platform was founded as RailUSA, renamed Gulf & Atlantic Railways, acquired the remaining legacy Pinsly railroad and logistics businesses in 2023, and adopted the Pinsly Railroad Company name in 2024. Its nine railroads and related logistics businesses are subsidiaries or assets, while Regional Rail is a separate 3i-owned platform.

afterImage.description: Pinsly Railroad Company is a U.S. short-line freight-rail and logistics platform operating nine railroads across ten states. The business provides freight transportation, transload, railcar storage, industrial-development, warehousing and related logistics services to customers in agriculture, chemicals, fuels, plastics, building materials, lumber and metals. Macquarie Infrastructure Partners V acquired 100% of predecessor RailUSA in 2022. The platform later operated as Gulf & Atlantic Railways, acquired the legacy Pinsly railroad and logistics businesses in 2023, and adopted the Pinsly name in 2024. The operating railroads and logistics subsidiaries are components of this single manager-level platform.
